message.text: I remember SQLite requires PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON for FK enforcement, so I should check how the DSN is configured in sqlite.go.

SQLite opens with foreign_keys off, so ON DELETE CASCADE doesn't actually fire there, meaning memo_share rows could be orphaned unless the code explicitly deletes them. I want to search the store for where DeleteMemo handles memo_share cleanup.

message.text: I notice DeleteMemo doesn't explicitly delete memo_share rows—that only happens via FK cascade, which SQLite has disabled by default while Postgres/MySQL enforce it. So the affected tables are memo, memo_relation, attachment, and memo_share (cascade behavior varies by dialect). I should also verify that DeleteAttachment/DeleteAttachments only touch the attachment table.
